blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police (PNP) confirmed that criminal charges have been filed against Thomas Markle Sr., the estranged father of Meghan Markle, Duchess of Sussex, over alleged child sexual abuse material. In a message to reporters, PNP spokesperson Police Brigadier General Allen Rae Co said the charges are for violations of the Anti-Online Sexual Abuse or Exploitation of Children (OSAEC) and Anti-Child Sexual Abuse or Exploitation Materials (CSAEM) Act. “After thorough investigation, the Women and Children Protection Center-Visayas Field Unit filed criminal complaints against Thomas Markle Sr. before the Prosecutor’s Office,” said Co.
